text: More importantly, we believe it must focus on developing entirely new concepts in textile processing, as with the Unifil loom winder and our more recent Uniconer automatic coning machine. Our budget has increased on this basis. Our already substantial research and development budget has been raised further in recent years to support the ongoing engineering and design work essential to Leesona’s future growth in sales and earnings. Much of this necessary increase in research and development, while properly charged to current expenses, is not reflected in earnings until projects are completed and the new machines are sold in volume, usually over several years.
